values.value: You built, repaired, and maintained structures, systems, and equipment in field conditions where the usual support was not available. You read plans and blueprints, operated heavy machinery, worked with utilities, and kept projects moving with the materials and crew on hand. You understand construction sequencing, safety, and how to stay on schedule when things do not go as planned.

Combat engineer and Seabee experience maps directly to the scope and pace of this role.", "onet": "11-9021.00"}, {"title": "Heavy Equipment Operator", "description": "You operate bulldozers, cranes, excavators, and similar machinery to move earth, place materials, and support construction. Most heavy equipment — bulldozers, excavators, loaders — requires no license under federal OSHA, which mandates employer-provided training rather than a separate operator credential; state requirements vary, and some states (such as Massachusetts) license hoisting operators including excavators. Cranes over 2,000 lbs are the main exception: 29 CFR 1926.1427 requires NCCCO or equivalent third-party certification. Military equipment operator training and documentation is well-regarded by civilian employers and gives you a strong foundation for both licensed and unlicensed roles.", "onet": "47-2073.00"}, {"title": "Utilities Technician", "description": "You install, maintain, and repair water, electrical, or HVAC systems in buildings or facilities. Field experience with utilities in forward operating environments is a direct match for this work.", "onet": "49-9051.00"}, {"title": "Construction Inspector", "description": "You inspect construction work in progress to make sure it meets code, plans, and safety requirements. You document findings, write reports, and communicate issues to contractors and project managers.", "onet": "47-4011.00"}, {"title": "Estimator", "description": "You calculate the cost of construction projects by reviewing plans, quantifying materials and labor, and producing bids or budgets. Engineering sergeant and project coordination experience gives you the foundation to move into this analytical role.", "onet": "13-1051.00"}]
